key_insight: The paper removes slack variables and makes inequality-constrained quantum optimization trainable by combining unbalanced penalization with the Ohzeki method and deep unfolding.
engineering_relevance: This reduces qubit/embedding overhead and penalty-tuning burden for mapping constrained combinatorial problems to quantum annealers.
method: Introduce UPOM to handle inequality constraints without slack variables.
Replace UP's two fixed penalty coefficients with an auxiliary-variable update rule.
Deep-unfold the update schedule (DU-UPOM) so step sizes are learned from training instances.
evidence_signal: On random knapsack benchmarks, UPOM outperformed original UP, and DU-UPOM reached optimal solutions in fewer iterations than fixed-step UPOM and other baselines.
watch_item: The learned step-size schedule may generalize imperfectly beyond the training problem distribution and still requires careful validation on new instances.
paper_title: Slack-Free Deep-Unfolded Combinatorial Optimization Solver for Inequality Constraints
